erinith_1.m: Please, you have to help me!

erinith_complete_1.m: Thank you for all your help earlier.

erinith_gavepotion_1.m: Wow, I feel slightly better already. I guess this healing really works.

erinith_gavepotion_bm_1.m: Bonemeal potion? But ... but ... we are not allowed to use them since they are prohibited by Lord Geomyr.
r: I have tried them myself, it's perfectly safe to use them.

erinith_gavepotion_bm_2.m:
Hmm, yes. I guess you have a point. Oh well, here goes.
[Drinks potion]

erinith_gavepotion_major_1.m:
Thank you for bringing me one.
[Drinks potion]

erinith_gavepotion_reg_1.m:
Thank you for bringing them to me.
[Drinks all four potions]

erinith_givenpotion_1.m: Thank you my friend for your help. My book is safe and my wound is healing. I hope our paths will cross again.

erinith_needsbook_1.m: Have you found that book yet?
r: Not yet, I am still looking.

erinith_needsbook_3_1.m: You found it! Oh thank you so much. I was so worried that I had lost it.

erinith_needsbook_3_2.m: You found it! Oh thank you so much. In return, here is the gold I promised you.

erinith_needspotions_1.m: Thank you for helping me find my book earlier.

erinith_needspotions_2.m: I am still hurt by this wound that I got from the attack during the night.

erinith_needspotions_3.m: Ack, it hurts so bad and it doesn't seem to be healing itself.

erinith_needspotions_4.m: I am really in need of some stronger healing here. Maybe some potions would do.

erinith_needspotions_5.m: I have heard that the potion makers these days have major potions of health, and not just the regular potions of health.

erinith_needspotions_6.m: One of those would surely do. Otherwise, I think four regular potions of health would be enough.
r: I'll go get those potions for you.
Here, take this bonemeal potion instead. It's very potent in healing deep wounds.
Here, take this major potion of health.
Here, take this major flask of health.
Here, take these four regular potions of health.

erinith_needspotions_7.m: Thank you my friend. Please hurry back.

erinith_story_1.m: I was setting up camp here during the night, and was attacked by some bandits while asleep.

erinith_story_2.m: Ack, this wound doesn't seem to be healing itself.

erinith_story_3.m: At least I managed to keep them from getting my book. I'm sure they were after the book.
r: Seems like a valuable book then. This sounds interesting, please go on.

erinith_story_4.m:
I managed to throw the book in among the trees over there during the attack.
[Points to the trees directly to the north]

erinith_story_5.m: I don't think they managed to get the book. It's probably still somewhere among those trees.

r: I could help you find that book if you want.
What would it be worth for you to get that book back?

erinith_story_8.m: Please go look for it among those trees to the northeast.

erinith_story_gold_1.m: Worth? Well, I was hoping you would help me anyway, but I guess 200 gold could do.
r: 200 gold it is then. I'll go look for your book.
A lousy 200 gold, is that all you can do? Fine, I'll go look for your stupid book.
Keep your gold, I'll return your book for you anyway.
No, I am not getting involved in this. Goodbye.

erinith.10: Just northeast of Crossglen village, I met Erinith that has set up camp. Apparently, he was attacked during the night and lost a book.
erinith.20: I have agreed to help Erinith find his book. He told me he threw it among some trees to the north of his camp.
erinith.21: I have agreed to help Erinith find his book in return for 200 gold. He told me he threw it among some trees to the north of his camp.
erinith.30: I have returned the book to Erinith.
erinith.31: He also needs help with his wound that doesn't seem to be healing. Either I should bring him one potion of major health, or four regular potions of health.
erinith.40: I gave Erinith a bonemeal potion to heal his wound. He was a bit scared to use it since they are prohibited by Lord Geomyr.
erinith.41: I gave Erinith a potion of a major health to heal his wound.
erinith.42: I gave Erinith four regular potions of health to heal his wound.
erinith.50: The wound healed completely and Erinith thanked me for all the help.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
